keyword: when is the launch to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Live launch day updates for NASA’s Artemis II test flight... All times are Eastern.' (dated 2026/04/01); R2: 'Artemis II Launch Update: April 1, 2026'; R5: 'Nasa is targeting 18:24 Eastern Daylight Time on 1 April'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the scheduled launch date as April 1, 2026, with live updates and targeting specifics.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight around the Moon since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The first crewed deep-space flight in over 50 years'; R2: 'For the first time since Apollo 17, humans will venture toward the Moon!'; R3: 'The historic and risky lunar venture will mark the first time astronauts return to the vicinity of the moon in more than 50 years.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is the first crewed mission around the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission will lift off from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida'; multiple mentions of LC 39B throughout.
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of launch site as Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission has backup windows in early April 2026.

verifications.reasoning: Sources list specific backup windows in early April 2026 (April 2-6).
